climate: Test the air conditioning and photograph the outdoor unit and thermostat; summer heat makes a broken AC an urgent repair, and monsoon storms can leave dust and roof damage worth recording.
fact: Arizona law requires landlords to register residential rentals with the county assessor, so Glendale rentals should appear in the Maricopa County Assessor's records.
